description: Fetch official Iranian yearly rates from the database: minimum wage (min_wage), court filing fees (court_fee_*), salary tax exemption (salary_tax_exemption_annual), Central Bank price index for delay damages (cbi_price_index), daily severance (sanavat_daily). حق‌الوکاله is NOT an annual rate — use calculate_lawyer_fee. ALWAYS use this instead of recalling a rate — yearly figures are exactly what models misremember. For دیه use calculate_diyeh instead. Read each row's `unit` field: «rials» means Rial and «درصد» means percent — never report a percentage as a Rial amount.

rate_type.description: Rate key, e.g. min_wage, court_fee_financial_first, cbi_price_index, sanavat_daily.

year_jalali.description: Persian year (optional — defaults to the latest available).

name: lookup_annual_rate
title: نرخ‌های رسمی سالانه — Look up official yearly rates
